sheratan All errors

warning · caught by sheratan check

SHR-T001A module's state or effects has no test beside it

State is pure functions and effects need one fake contract, so both are cheap to test, and they are where the logic is. The test sits beside the file it covers, under its name, so a missing one shows.

Wrong

sheratan check reports SHR-T001.

Right

Checks clean.

In your terminal

sheratan explain SHR-T001          # this page
sheratan explain SHR-T001 --json   # the same, for an agent
Every example here is run by Sheratan's test suite: the wrong one must be caught with its code, the right one must not.
